summary: Adds TanStack Query placeholderData (keep previous data) to 11 list queries (documents, templates, inbox, org teams, webhook call logs, and admin claims/jobs/email transports/org stats/organisations/user teams), so tables keep showing the previous page instead of blanking to a loading skeleton while the next page, search or filter loads.

statements.why: Every changed file is user-facing UI: the Documents, Templates and Inbox lists plus several settings/admin tables now behave differently while paging/searching (old rows stay on screen instead of a loading state).

misses.what: Paging, searching or filtering the Documents, Templates, Inbox, org Teams, webhook logs and admin tables now keeps the previous rows visible until new results arrive, instead of flashing an empty/loading table.
While the new page loads, isLoading stays false so there is no loading indicator; users can briefly see (and click) results from the previous page/search/folder.
